name: Ample
description: Deploy the project to ample.computer from a panel in the sidebar.

chatShortcuts.help: Runs the Ample checks for this project and, when they pass, deploys it.
chatShortcuts.instructions: The shortcut !ship means: call the check tool. If it reports problems, say what they are and stop. Otherwise call the deploy tool and tell the person where it went.

chatTools.description: Check the project's ample.toml and what a deploy would do, without deploying.
Deploy the project to Ample. Needs the checks to pass first.

settings.label: Check the project whenever ample.toml changes
